title: Mission Control memory GUI online
body: The non-Paperclip Mission Control memory server is serving the built GUI and shared memory endpoints on localhost port 8787.

title: Mission Control progression board repaired
body: progress/status was returning 500 because /mnt/c/antigravity/memory/mission-control-progress-tasks.json had "[PHONE].125" literals where the memory-server.mjs parser expected numeric updatedAt. Replaced with current epoch floats, backed up to .bak-* and validated JSON. /progress/status now returns 200 with 3 nodes (Sabretooth a1523c7, T5500 a771e9b, 9020 a771e9b — sameRepoHead=false because Sabretooth lags) and 9 tasks across todo/doing/blocked/done. e2e Playwright run now 2/2 passing after `npx playwright install chromium`. Next: investigate why Sabretooth repo head is behind origin/main.
